old: \textbf{Certification statistics.} The 42 single-scenario evaluations of the certification campaign are evaluations 3--11, 15, 22, 23, 26--31, 34--39 and 42--59 of Table~\ref{tab:appE_evaluations}. Of these, 32 certified, 24 on the oscillatory branch and 8 on the monotone branch; the 10 uncertified divide into 5 refused by the gap clause, 2 reset by residual lapses and 3 failed by the growth test. The median certification cycle was 174, and certification came a median 65 cycles after the first residual pass (range 21--89); the median ratio of the window range to $\tau$ at certification was 0.86. The four evaluations added later (32, 33, 60 and 61) all certified. Ten of the 46 certificates the tables use stop within 5\,\% of $\tau$ (evaluations 2, 3, 5, 10, 11, 12, 14, 17, 20 and 23; evaluation~36, at 0.94 on the monotone branch, is just below), so the rule bounds the stopping error of each evaluation at about $\tau$, not well inside it. The three evaluations continued past their certificates, 12, 14 and 3, moved by a further 0.004$\tau$, 0.74$\tau$ and 0.78--0.88$\tau$. After the first residual pass, 21 cycles in 10 evaluations had a local solve that was not clean, all in transmission blocks (column N.c.), while the 119 exits at IPOPT's acceptable level within ten times the tight-tail tolerances, all in distribution blocks, were counted as clean.
